rdl.criteria: Slight fixed knee flexion, hips move backward, neutral trunk, long arms, bar close to legs; return upright with hips.

goblet-squat.criteria: One vertical dumbbell supported at chest with both hands, planted feet turned slightly out, elbows down, squat to parallel and stand.

front-squat.criteria: Bar on front shoulder rack, elbows forward, upright torso, planted feet, controlled squat to parallel and return.

limits: Procedural animation reuses existing human and leg IK. New exercise-specific arms, equipment, timing and camera. Simplified anatomy and grip; no full mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Production and physical device pending.
